units.source_text: 贫瘠的旱田向多石的荒地延伸，

en.t: The barren dry fields stretched toward stony wasteland,
most of the wild grass had already withered,

units.source_text: 尚未枯萎而呈现绿色的，只有紧贴地面上的苔藓般的杂草。

en.t: and the only things still green and unwithered were moss-like weeds clinging close to the ground.

units.source_text: 这种杂草的叶子也卷曲了，走了。

en.t: Even the leaves of these weeds had curled up and disappeared.

units.source_text: 那一带已是一片沙土了。

en.t: The whole area had already become a stretch of sandy soil.
